Combining innovative therapeutic modalities with skilled, compassionate care, JAG PT (formerly JAG-ONE PT) is New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania’s leading source for physical therapy, occupational therapy, orthopedic rehabilitation, and more.

Our 100+ locations throughout the tri-state area offer a vast array of specialized therapies customized to your specific needs and your lifestyle, from manual therapy and aquatic rehabilitation and from the Schroth method to vestibular system rehabilitation, among many others. JAG PT’s empathetic staff is proud to treat patients from all walks of life - schoolchildren, professional athletes, seniors, and everyone in between.

Visit us at jagpt.com today to learn more about our locations near you and our slate of effective therapeutic services or conveniently schedule your appointment.
